captions.linkedin:
Most traders called value dead after 2020. Fama and French published the HML spread with a t-statistic of 2.91 across 28 years. That's not noise. That's a signal that worked, decayed, and now divides the entire profession.

Here's the original logic from JFE 1993. No black box:

🔹 BOOK-TO-MARKET SORT. Split stocks into value and growth using BE/ME ratios at the 30/70 NYSE breakpoints.
🔹 SIZE-NEUTRAL. Average high and low across 2 market-cap buckets so small-caps don't drive the spread.
🔹 JUNE FORMATION. Annual rebalance at fiscal year-end gives you a clean accounting data lag.
🔹 VALUE-WEIGHTED. Positions inside each portfolio sized by market equity.
🔹 ZERO-COST SPREAD. Long value funded by short growth, dollar-neutral.

Fama and French 1993, sample ends July 1991. The 2007 to 2020 drawdown is real. The five-factor model from 2015 makes HML redundant when profitability and investment are added. You verify it.
